trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 3815907. The zbMATH web and API endpoints were not readable in this environment; shell curl attempts for zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org failed with DNS resolution errors. Local resolver metadata in outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv identifies the record as "Near-rings of continuous selfmaps: A brief survey and some open problems" (1982) and lists no full-text links.

Bounded recovery classified the failure as metadata_only. Exact-title and proceedings searches for the same work found citation-only sources or different works: Nearring Bibliography and the zbMATH author-profile snippet were bibliographic metadata only; Cambridge, EUDML, Springer, and later article candidates were different papers or references; CiNii listed the San Benedetto del Tronto proceedings only as library holdings. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML primary source was recovered.
